fib: ______ is a form of genetic drift that occurs when a population is drastically reduced in size.
Bottleneck effect
Bottleneck effect is a form of genetic drift that occurs when a population is drastically reduced in size.
______ is a statistical tool used to test a population for Hardy- Weinberg equilibrium.
Chi-square test
Chi-square test is a statistical tool used to test a population for Hardy- Weinberg equilibrium.
______ is the source of genetic variations in populations.
Mutation
Mutation is the source of genetic variations in populations.
______ can be defined as the genetic (or allelic) constitution of an organism.
Genotype
Genotype can be defined as the genetic (or allelic) constitution of an organism.
______ is the study of genetics at the population level.
Population genetics
Population genetics is the study of genetics at the population level.
______ is the mating of related individuals, and outbreeding is the mating of genetically unrelated individuals.
Inbreeding
Inbreeding is the mating of related individuals, and outbreeding is the mating of genetically unrelated individuals.
______ is the dominant force in the evolution of many traits and has shaped much of the phenotypic variation observed in nature.
Natural selection
Natural selection is the dominant force in the evolution of many traits and has shaped much of the phenotypic variation observed in nature.
______ can be defined as a group of individuals that exist in time and space and can interbreed.
population
A population can be defined as a group of individuals that exist in time and space and can interbreed.
